title: Managing clients
text: View, add, edit and delete your client's details from the Clients page. Each client profile tracks their booking history, contact info, and notes.

title: Service menu
text: Add the services your business offers, set pricing and duration, and organize them into categories clients see when booking.

title: Service add-ons
text: Add-ons let clients customize a booking with optional extras (e.g. a deep conditioning treatment) for an additional charge and time.

title: Service consumables
text: Track back-bar products a service uses (e.g. color, developer) so stock is automatically deducted when the appointment is completed.

title: Staff member wages
text: Set up how a staff member earns — hourly wage, salary, or a mix — so wages calculate correctly on their pay runs and timesheets.

title: Pay run settings
text: Choose how a staff member is paid (bank transfer, cash, etc.) and which fees or deductions are automatically applied during a pay run.

title: Staff member commissions
text: Configure commission rates a staff member earns on services, products, memberships, and gift cards they sell, plus deductions applied to those calculations.

title: Managing your staff
text: Add staff members, assign roles and access levels, and manage their availability from the Staff page.

title: Pay runs
text: Calculate and settle what you owe your staff — tips, commissions, and wages — for a given pay period, then mark the run as paid.

title: Suppliers
text: Keep track of the suppliers you buy stock from, including contact details, so you can link them to stock orders.

title: Stock orders
text: Create and track orders placed with suppliers to replenish your product stock, and receive stock against an order once it arrives.

title: Repeating shifts
text: Set a weekly, biweekly, or custom shift pattern for a staff member. Changes you save apply to all upcoming shifts for the selected period.

title: Products
text: Add retail products to sell at checkout, track stock on hand, and set supply/retail pricing and markup.
